title: How one tweet can ruin your life | Jon Ronson
summary: Jon Ronson's TED talk on public shaming on Twitter, centered on Justine Sacco and others whose lives were upended by online mobs. He argues we have become a baying crowd and should rethink how we treat each other online.
why: HN commenters bring it up in threads about online mobs and cancellation as a relevant talk by a journalist who interviewed shamed people.

quote.text: I'm reminded of this TED talk in these scenarios, by a journalist and author who interviewed many people who have been publicly shamed
